posts.en:
dsh-mcp-lens is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Progressive-disclosure MCP gateway that searches large remote catalogs through `mcp_search`, then invokes exact schemas through `mcp_call` with lazy connections and bounded caches.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-636f37c61db6b4e3ac2e.html
